evidence.title: GitHub - jooohyunpark/grid: An opinionated grid system for React and Tailwind

name: Grid
summary: An opinionated 12-column grid system for React and Tailwind with type-safe responsive span, gap and start props.
description: Grid adds a 12-column layout system on top of CSS grid for React and Tailwind: Grid and GridColumn components with type-safe responsive props (span, start, rowSpan, rowStart, gap). Copy-paste install, no runtime and no dependencies; requires React 19+ and Tailwind CSS v4. The original teul.joohyun.dev address now returns 404; the project is served at grid.joohyunpark.com.
contains: type-safe responsive props (span, start, rowSpan, gap)
requires React 19+ and Tailwind CSS v4
copy-paste install, no runtime or dependencies
site moved from teul.joohyun.dev to grid.joohyunpark.com
